description: This file defines the AuthParams class within the OrangeHRM authentication module. The class implements the AuthParamsInterface and encapsulates user credentials and authentication attributes, providing getter methods with cloning to ensure immutability.

classes.name: AuthParams
classes.description: A class representing authentication parameters, including user credentials and attribute bags, used during the authentication process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing AuthParams with user credentials and optional attribute bag.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Returns a clone of the stored user credentials.

methods.name: getAttributeBag
methods.description: Returns a clone of the stored attribute bag.
